shadows.name: accent-lift
shadows.purpose: Under primary buttons and the nav CTA; deepens on hover.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Revealed only on work-card hover; soft offset+blur, no ambient rest shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and the scroll-reveal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action (See my work, Send message, Get in touch).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:#3b82f6; color:#fff; font-weight:500; font-size:0.98rem; padding:0.8rem 1.6rem; border:none; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 20px -6px rgba(59,130,246,0.5); transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#5b9bff; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 12px 30px -8px rgba(59,130,246,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The hero's secondary action; hairline-outlined, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.8rem 1.6rem; font-weight:500; font-size:0.98rem; color:#f4f4f6; background:transparent; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#16161b; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.28); }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: A single deployed project: screenshot well + title + blurb + Visit-site link; the whole card is one link.
components.html:
Bella's Pizza

A cosy wood-fired pizzeria in a warm, appetising layout.

Visit site ↗
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#0d0d10; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.16); box-shadow:0 26px 50px -28px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-card-thumb { aspect-ratio:16/10; background:#121216; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-card-body { padding:1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.6rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#f4f4f6; } .ds-card-text { color:#8a8a95; font-size:0.94rem; } .ds-card-link { color:#3b82f6; font-weight:500; font-size:0.92rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form field with an Ink-Muted label above (no placeholder).
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.4rem; } .ds-field span { font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:500; color:#8a8a95; } .ds-field input { font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.98rem; padding:0.72rem 0.85rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:8px; background:#08080a; color:#f4f4f6; transition:border-color .18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#3b82f6; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.14); }

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: Fixed translucent top bar: lowercase wordmark, muted links, Signal-Blue CTA pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.5rem; padding:0.85rem 1.5rem; background:rgba(8,8,10,0.82); backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(1.4); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.08rem; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#f4f4f6; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-logo span { color:#3b82f6; } .ds-nav-links { margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:1.9rem; } .ds-nav-links a { color:#8a8a95; font-size:0.9rem; text-decoration:none; transition:color .18s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color:#f4f4f6; } .ds-nav-cta { background:#3b82f6; color:#fff; font-weight:500; font-size:0.9rem; padding:0.5rem 1.05rem; border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 4px 14px -4px rgba(59,130,246,0.5); }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: The 'In progress' marker on unfinished work; Geist Mono uppercase in Status Amber.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.66rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; font-weight:500; padding:0.24rem 0.55rem; border-radius:8px; color:#f0b24a; background:rgba(240,178,74,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(240,178,74,0.22); }

narrative.overview: brownbuilds is a near-black room where the work is the light. The interface is deliberately quiet - deep ink ground, hairline edges, a single confident grotesk, and generous air - so the only saturated thing on screen is the work itself: real, deployed client sites shown at full brightness inside flat cards. The confidence comes from restraint, not effects. The register is calm and professional, benchmarked against Vercel-class product marketing, and it is an explicit rejection of the animated-aurora, glassmorphism, gradient-text default it replaced.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, never pure black; flat matte surfaces, never glass.
One restrained blue accent, used sparingly for action and emphasis.
Geist grotesk throughout; big, tightly-tracked headlines.
Hairline 1px borders and lots of air instead of boxes and shadows.
Client screenshots are the only rich colour on the page.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only decorative colour on the page. Green and amber appear only as status signals at a few pixels each. If a screen has more than one blue region competing for attention, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight, size, or the single flat accent - never from a gradient. Gradient text and multi-stop backgrounds are banned outright.

rules.name: The Tight-Track Rule
rules.body: Large type gets negative tracking (down to -0.04em on display); body stays near -0.01em. Headlines are set tight and confident, not airy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a reaction (hover, action), never ambient furniture. Every shadow carries a real offset and blur - no zero-blur glows.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue on <=10% of any screen; let the client screenshots be the colour.
Do convey depth with tonal layers and hairlines; reserve shadows for hover/action.
Do set headlines in Geist at 600 with tight negative tracking.
Do keep green and amber strictly as status signals, a few pixels each.
Do draw icons as single-stroke SVG.
donts: Don't use gradient text or multi-stop gradient backgrounds anywhere.
Don't reintroduce glassmorphism, aurora blobs, or neon glow.
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker above a heading, or number sections 01/02/03.
Don't wrap content in same-size icon+title+text boxes as the page structure.
Don't add a second competing accent colour; the palette is one blue plus neutrals.
